title: The duplicate refusal toast shows HTML in a part number as plain text
custom_preconds:
• A part stocked here whose number contains HTML, e.g. <b>QAX10820</b> (create it through the API).
  • Parts > Inventory.
custom_steps: 1. New Inventory Part: Description, Part Number "<b>qax10820</b>" (different case), Category, Cost; Save.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • Toast "<b>QAX10820</b> already exists at this location." naming the stocked number.
  • The <b> tags show as literal text; nothing is bold or rendered as HTML (SR-4).
  • The dialog stays open.
